name: What is the installation process for triple-pane windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for triple-pane windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process for triple-pane windows typically begins with a consultation and measurement to ensure a precise fit. On installation day, our team will carefully remove your old windows, prepare the openings, and then expertly install the new triple-pane units. This includes sealing and insulating around the frames to maximize energy efficiency and prevent drafts. We ensure proper flashing and trim, followed by a thorough cleanup. The duration varies based on the number of windows and complexity, but our goal is a seamless, efficient replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: The installation process involves consultation, removal of old windows, expert installation of new units with proper sealing and insulation, and a thorough cleanup.
